title: The Value-Led Services Motion

steps.line: Quantify the enterprise problem and what solving it is worth — before anything is positioned or sold.
Apply the right specialist capability — solution sales, pre-sales, solution architecture, business value — to the specific pursuit.
Drive adoption and measure against the business case, so value is visible to the customer's own leadership.
Let proven value fund the next use case, the next division, the next market.

philosophy: Right expertise, faster value, measurable outcome, expansion.
notPhilosophy: Not the capacity model: more people, more hours, more revenue.
